html:
G'oya

Maoshlarni takrorsiz olamiz, kattasidan kichigiga saralaymiz va ikkitasini o'tkazib yuboramiz: DISTINCT, ORDER BY salary DESC, LIMIT 1 OFFSET 2. Qolgan ish: uchinchi maosh bo'lmasa ham bitta NULL qator qaytarish. Buni skalyar subquery hal qiladi.

Yechim

SELECT (
  SELECT DISTINCT salary
  FROM employees
  ORDER BY salary DESC
  LIMIT 1 OFFSET 2
) AS third_salary

Tashqi SELECT da FROM yo'q, shuning uchun u doim bitta qator qaytaradi. Ichki so'rov bo'sh chiqsa, uning o'rniga NULL qo'yiladi. Namunada maoshlar 9, 7, 5 va 4 million, javob 5 000 000.

Tuzoqlar

Subquery'siz yozilsa, uchinchi maosh yo'q bo'lganda natija bo'sh jadval bo'ladi, NULL li bitta qator emas:

Noto'g'riSELECT DISTINCT salary AS third_salary
FROM employees
ORDER BY salary DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 2

DISTINCT siz takroriy maoshlar alohida o'rin egallaydi. 300, 300, 200, 100 da uchinchi qator 200 bo'ladi, to'g'ri javob esa 100.

Boshqa yo'l

Har qadamda oldingi eng kattasidan kichik bo'lgan eng katta maoshni olish:

SELECT MAX(salary) AS third_salary
FROM employees
WHERE salary < (
  SELECT MAX(salary) FROM employees
  WHERE salary < (SELECT MAX(salary) FROM employees)
)

Bo'sh to'plamda MAX NULL qaytaradi, shuning uchun bu variant ham uchinchi maosh yo'qligini o'zi hal qiladi. Takrorlar ham muammo emas. Lekin N-chi maosh uchun N ta ichma-ich so'rov kerak bo'ladi, OFFSET da esa faqat sonni o'zgartirasiz.
